introHtml: Full color decoration brings your logo or artwork to life on bowls, plates, and trays with vivid, photographic-quality detail. Unlike single-color imprints, full color allows gradients, complex graphics, and even product images to appear exactly as designed. This makes it ideal for corporate picnics, trade show giveaways, or restaurant-branded serveware where visual impact matters. Common decoration methods include full-color transfer or digital print, which work well on melamine, ceramic, or bamboo surfaces. The result is a premium look that stands out on any buffet or display table.
